name: 28304 · Fayetteville, NC
findings: ZIP 28304 (Fayetteville) has 88 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28304 (Fayetteville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28304 (Fayetteville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 61% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 28304 (Fayetteville) list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
